description: A named set of configuration activated with spring.profiles.active, kept small because each one is a combination to test.
Settings supplied from outside the artifact, such as environment variables, that override the files packaged in the jar.
A value that grants access, supplied at run time and kept out of source control, images and logs.
A spring.config.import source that turns each file in a mounted folder into a property named after the file.
Stopping by refusing new requests and letting in-flight requests finish within spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase.
Two probes: liveness asks whether to restart the process and readiness asks whether it should receive traffic now.
A set of reusable database connections, whose total across all instances must stay below the database limit.
A rollout that replaces instances gradually, using readiness to decide when a new instance may receive traffic.
